items.briefing:
The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway — products commonly used by organisations to manage secure remote access. If your organisation uses these products, IT teams should apply patches immediately, as attackers can exploit these flaws to gain unauthorised access to systems and data.

Additionally, large organisations are being targeted by convincing fake merger and acquisition scams, where criminals impersonate executives or advisors to trick staff into transferring funds or sharing sensitive information. With Australia's privacy law reforms also on the horizon, now is a good time to review how your organisation handles personal data. **Tip:** If you receive an unexpected request involving financial transactions or sensitive data, always verify through a separate, trusted channel before acting.
